summary: El Salvador's Foreign Ministry sorts passports into category A (exempt from visa), category B (consular visa without consultation) and category C (consulted visa), and its migration law treats tourists as staying up to 90 calendar days. The UK and Canadian governments say their citizens do not need a visa. The UK government says you can travel between El Salvador, Guatemala and Nicaragua for up to 90 days without a visa, and that the 90-day period starts when you enter any of these countries and does not restart when you cross borders.

tips.text: The UK government says you can travel between El Salvador, Guatemala and Nicaragua for up to 90 days without a visa, and that the 90-day period starts when you enter any of these countries and does not restart when you cross borders. Migración's form F44 covers an extension of a non-resident's stay of 1 to 90 days.

The UK government says the state of exception started in 2022 and has remained in place since, and that it gives police additional powers, resulting in a much higher number of arrests, sometimes without much evidence. Canada says you may be subject to identity checks and to always carry valid identification.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for El Salvador?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. El Salvador's Foreign Ministry sorts passports into category A (exempt from visa), category B (consular visa without consultation) and category C (consulted visa), and its migration law treats tourists as staying up to 90 calendar days. The UK government says British visitors can travel to El Salvador for tourism or business without a visa, and Canada says Canadians need no tourist visa.

faq.question: Do visitors still need the entry card (tourist card)?
faq.answer: The consolidated text of the Special Migration and Aliens Act published by El Salvador's Supreme Court shows Article 328, on the entry card (Tarjeta Migratoria de Ingreso), as repealed by Decreto Legislativo No. 286 of 30 April 2025. No official source we could read states a current fee for an entry card.

faq.question: Does time in Guatemala or Honduras count against my El Salvador stay?
faq.answer: The UK government says you can travel between El Salvador, Guatemala and Nicaragua for up to 90 days without a visa, that the CA-4 Agreement also includes Honduras, and that the 90-day period starts when you enter any of these countries and does not restart when you cross borders. Migración's form F44 covers an extension of a non-resident's stay of 1 to 90 days.

faq.question: Is El Salvador safe to visit now?
faq.answer: The UK government says security in El Salvador has improved considerably with significant reductions in crime, but the risks of violent and petty crime still exist. It says a state of exception started in 2022 and gives police additional powers, and advises always carrying a copy of the photo page of your passport; Canada advises always cooperating with military and police officers and always carrying valid identification.
